arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# 1996 New AA municipal bond yields (monthly)
yields = {
    'Jan': 5.41,
    'Feb': 5.41,
    'Mar': 5.57,
    'Apr': 5.72,
    'May': 5.73,
    'June': 5.82,
    'July': 5.82,
    'Aug': 5.69,
    'Sept': 5.62,
    'Oct': 5.53,
    'Nov': 5.47,
    'Dec': 5.47
}

# Calculate log returns: ln(Pt/Pt-1)
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
log_returns = []

for i in range(1, len(months)):
    pt = yields[months[i]]
    pt_1 = yields[months[i-1]]
    log_return = math.log(pt / pt_1)
    log_returns.append(log_return)
    print(f"{months[i-1]} to {months[i]}: {pt}/{pt_1} = {pt/pt_1:.6f}, ln = {log_return:.6f}")

print(f"\nTotal log returns: {len(log_returns)}")
print(f"Log returns: {log_returns}")

# Sort returns for percentile calculation
sorted_returns = sorted(log_returns)
print(f"\nSorted returns: {sorted_returns}")

# Find 5th percentile using nearest-rank method (no interpolation)
# For n observations, the rank is ceil(p * n)
n = len(log_returns)
p = 0.05
rank = math.ceil(p * n)
print(f"\nRank for 5th percentile: ceil({p} * {n}) = {rank}")

# The 5th percentile is at index rank-1 (0-indexed)
percentile_index = rank - 1
percentile_value = sorted_returns[percentile_index]
print(f"5th percentile (worst) return: {percentile_value:.6f}")

# Convert to percentage loss (absolute value)
var_percentage = abs(percentile_value) * 100
print(f"\nVaR as percentage loss: {var_percentage:.4f}%")
print(f"VaR rounded to nearest hundredth: {var_percentage:.2f}%")
EOF
